_instructions: Milestone 0 search oracles: 10 questions a bill auditor would ask, each labelled with the manual section(s) that answer it.
Expected sections were chosen from the manual's contents before any search output was looked at.
Section ids are chapter + letter, e.g. 'I.E' (Modifiers and Modifier Indicators) or 'XI.U' (E&M services).
Wordings are mixed: the manual's own terms, plain patient language, and questions naming a code or modifier.
